ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across approx. 95% of the visible surface area, with sparse high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized to the distal right region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark pigmentation across the bilateral field; focal high-contrast white pixel clusters (mottling) observed on the distal portion of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge displays high-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (sharp peaks and valleys); left lobe displays low-frequency, low-amplitude undulations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves extending from the central region toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters on the distal surface of the right lobe tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular serration profile and potential tissue loss along the trailing edge of the right lobe compared to the smoother left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant morphological asymmetry between the trailing edge topography of the left and right lobes.
